observations.title: MixinExtras role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Extends Mixin injection capabilities for developer integrations. Multiple embedded versions in a manifest are candidates for loader resolution, not evidence that every version runs simultaneously.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 0.2.0-beta.6, 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.3.1, 0.3.2, 0.3.5, 0.3.6, 0.4.1, 0.5.0-beta.2, 0.5.0-beta.5
